_doc: GoodQA #15565 ask hygiene. mode: off | warn | enforce (ship warn: enforce needs a replay over real asks with 0 false refusals first). human_only terms always keep an ask: the harness rules reserve these steps for a person, and anything that needs his email, phone, passkey, password, bank or approval is his. agent_doable rules flag an ask an agent can do itself. A GRANT: row of the user's own words in the main log flags asks that share min_shared words, one distinctive, with it.

agent_doable.why: stopping a process you own is `ah kill --pid N --reason R`; a foreign process needs the user's OK only for --foreign
an account the user already owns is reached through his GoodQA user token, an email approve link or device code, or secure-login (CLAUDE.md section 4)
an agent can run or look at this itself
